text:
alex wong: Quick update: Product approved a v6 preview pricebook for select strategic accounts. This is opt-in only. Key changes: new embeddings-pro SKU (better density at 500k+ vol), simplified GPU SKU tiers, and clarified promo stacking language. Preview artifacts will land in S3 Mon 08:00 PT.

priya shah: Who is eligible to opt-in without amendment? We have a couple of corporate accounts on rolling monthly commitments.

amiguel ortiz: Ops note: any change to billing SKU IDs requires a validation run in APAC pipeline. Last time APAC's validator rejected unknown SKUs.

alex wong: Eligibility: signed annual commits may be offered opt-in by AE via a one-line amendment (no term change). Monthly/flex requires a signed amendment and review. We consider this a "preview opt-in" not a full rate change; grandfathering rules remain for active commitments that do nothing.

priya shah: Can you post the SFDC query to find affected opportunities (POCs + monthly committed)?

alex wong: Sure, use:
```
SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, Commit_Length__c, Has_Active_POC__c, Applied_Ratecard__c
FROM Opportunity
WHERE Applied_Ratecard__c = 'v5.3'
AND (Commit_Length__c = 'monthly' OR Has_Active_POC__c = TRUE)
```
Export and run: /tools/pricing/impact --from v5.3 --to v6-preview --top 200 --format csv

miguel ortiz: Ops steps for APAC validator:
1) download preview CSV from s3://release-candidates/pricebooks/v6-preview/
2) run python infra/pricebook_validate.py --file apac-preview.csv --schema schemas/v2.json
3) if errors, post a ticket to #eng-infra with the validation output attached

ops-bot: Release artifacts created by pipeline rc-4210: pricebook_v6_preview_canonical.csv, apac-preview.csv, eu-preview.csv, amendment-template-v6-preview.md, embeddings-pro-spec.pdf. Tag: rc/v6-preview.

priya shah: Deal desk: does stacking order change? AEs have open discounts that multiply committed tiers currently.

alex wong: No change to stack math for preview. We only reworded precedence and added examples. If a customer requests a different math, escalate to pricing-product for a minor (not preview) release.

legal-team: Amendment templates include two variants: "preview opt-in" (short form) and "rate-math change" (requires full legal review). Use the preview template for opt-ins that do not alter contract duration or termination.

miguel ortiz: Quoting system check: run python tools/quote_check.py --ratecard v6-preview --since 2025-03-01 > /tmp/v6quotes.txt to find quotes that reference v5.3. Manual regen recommended for in-flight quotes.

priya shah: AEs asked for one-line copy to send to customers requesting the preview. Any suggestions?

alex wong: Suggested copy: "v6 preview introduces embeddings-pro and consolidated GPU SKUs; it's opt-in and may change quoted pricing for monthly/flex plans — contact deal desk to request an amendment."

priya shah: Thanks — I'll prep a short note for AE leads and flag the 6 highest-ARR POCs for prioritized outreach.

alex wong: Great. Ping me if there's an urgent enterprise that needs immediate amendment handling and I'll loop Legal/Deal Desk.
